pages.text: Tail lamps on its back end, and a veranda on its front.

The guard's van goes on the back of the train. It seats two, by the stove (which smokes while someone's aboard) and by the window.$(br2)Its brake works with the train's: with a van on, a train's brakes are half as strong again (two vans at most), so a heavy train stops quicker. And a train left with no engine is held by the van's handbrake.
